checks.assessment: All seven rooms reported; average, median, maximum and per-room MAE kept distinct. Targets with different units never averaged together.
No claim of accuracy for all 476 rooms or other buildings from this selected seven-room sample.
Candidate families and hypotheses informed by previous development results; this is not an independent confirmatory study.
No target-dependent row filtering, room-name routing or adjustment using held-room outputs. Original 13 input columns retained.
All room-hour-angle rows remain. Descriptive tolerance rates and worst-room rates accompany MAE; tolerances are not engineering standards.
The worst-room identity may change. Compare maxima across the same complete room set, not just previously difficult rooms.
Every planned output, selection policy and room is reported, including failed comparisons and tradeoffs.
24 declared candidates, no search expansion after outer scores, no significance tests or unsupported confidence intervals.
Protocol/config frozen before training; Mean_select is a declared control and is not promoted to the primary hypothesis after observing results.
This compares predictive procedures on simulated labels; it does not establish causal reasons for geometry-related errors or field performance.
Outer targets used only for scoring; the relative P10 inference uses its own predicted mean, never held-room true mean.

additional_limit: Minimizing inner worst-room error does not guarantee lower outer worst-room error. Repeated model development remains a limitation.
